sourceTitle: Biographical Stories (From: "True Stories of History and Biography")
description: "Biographical Stories" by Nathaniel Hawthorne is a collection of narratives aimed at children and young readers, written in the mid-19th century. The work captures the early lives of notable historical figures, including artists, scientists, and leaders, through engaging storytelling designed to instill moral values and historical knowledge in young minds.
